newsitem.title: USA: Boston Chicken named in investor suit.
newsitem.headline: Boston Chicken named in investor suit.

text.p: Investors in Boston Chicken Inc filed a class action against the company, alleging it issued false statements about the company's financial health and inflated the price of stock, plaintiffs' lawyers said Monday.
Filed in U.S. District Court in Colorado, the suit represents purchasers of Boston Chicken common stock between Aug. 13, 1996, and May 30, 1997, laywers said in a statement.

The law firm representing the shareholders, Stull, Stull & Brody, joins two other law firms that filed a class action on behalf of Boston Chichen shareholders on August 4, concerning the same purchasing period.
The complaint also names officers and directors of the company.

Specifically, the complaint alleges that Boston Chicken "concealed huge losses incurred by its Boston Market stores by improperly shifting those losses to the financial statements of companies controlled by BCI known as 'Area Developers,'" the statement said.
The suit seeks to recover damages, but no dollar amount was released.
"We believe the allegations are groundless and we intend to defend ourselves rigorously against them," said Rachel Biederman, a spokewoman for Boston Chicken.
Boston Chicken operates more than 1,500 retail food stores in the United States.
